#Module async

Promises, microtasks, buffers and host objects: the asynchronous core every other module builds on.

A promise's value is an i64 (a number, or the handle of a buffer or another object) plus a string (an error message, a text result). Reactions run as microtasks once it settles. There are no closures in Wasm, so then does not create a chained promise: a reaction that passes a result on resolves a promise of its own.

A buffer is the ArrayBuffer of this platform: bytes owned by the browser, passed between APIs without copies into the module's memory (fetch bodies, messages, socket frames), counted against page.max_fetch_bytes.

Exposed to: Window, Worker. Source: api/async.widl.

#Types

#handle Object : EventTarget

Any host object (not a node). Released with Object_release; freed with the page in any case.

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_Object).

#handle Promise : Object

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_Promise).

#handle Buffer : Object

An ArrayBuffer.

Checked by the browser on every call (lookup_Buffer).

#Promise_create

Promise Promise_create()

A pending promise the module settles itself.

Host: Promise_create :: proc(c: ^Call) -> u64

#Promise_resolve

void Promise_resolve(Promise promise, i64 value = 0, string text = "") raises

Fulfils a pending promise. Invalid_Argument when it is settled already.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Promise_resolve :: proc(c: ^Call, promise: Api_Promise, value: i64, text: string) -> Api_Error

#Promise_reject

void Promise_reject(Promise promise, i64 code, string message = "") raises

Rejects a pending promise with an Error code (or any value) and a message. Invalid_Argument when settled already.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Promise_reject :: proc(c: ^Call, promise: Api_Promise, code: i64, message: string) -> Api_Error

#Promise_then

void Promise_then(Promise promise, PromiseReaction callback, i32 user = 0)

Adds a reaction; queued at once when the promise is settled already.

Host: Promise_then :: proc(c: ^Call, promise: Api_Promise, callback: u32, user: i32)

#Buffer_create

Buffer Buffer_create(bytes data) raises

A buffer holding a copy of data. Quota past the page's memory limit.

#Buffer_alloc

Buffer Buffer_alloc(i64 length) raises

A zero-filled buffer of length bytes. Quota past the page's memory limit, Range for a negative length.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Buffer_alloc :: proc(c: ^Call, length: i64) -> (u64, Api_Error)

#Buffer_write

i32 Buffer_write(Buffer buffer, i64 offset, bytes source)

Copies source into the buffer at offset (what fits); returns how many bytes were written.

#Buffer_slice

Buffer Buffer_slice(Buffer buffer, i64 start, i64 end) raises

buffer.slice(start, end): a copy; negative positions count from the end. Quota past the page's memory limit.

Raises: returns an Error (see web).

Host: Buffer_slice :: proc(c: ^Call, buffer: Api_Buffer, start: i64, end: i64) -> (u64, Api_Error)
